name: Goon
ability: Each night, the 1st player to choose you with their ability is drunk until dusk. You become their alignment.
wakes: Only to be shown its new alignment when it changes.
interaction: Told: Its new alignment, if it changed.
drunk_or_poisoned: If drunk or poisoned, the choosing player is not made drunk and the Goon does not change alignment.

jinxes.text: If the Pit-Hag turns an evil player into the Goon, they can't turn good due to their own ability.

rulings.text: Being chosen by the Storyteller (e.g. Grandmother's grandchild) does not trigger the Goon.
The Goon changes alignment and makes the chooser drunk even if the chooser was already drunk or poisoned.
The Assassin can kill the Goon, and the Goon still turns evil.
Only the first player to choose the Goon each night is affected; the Drunk reminder is removed at dusk.

test_scenarios.name: Imp attacks Goon
test_scenarios.expected: Carol is drunk so Alice does not die; Alice becomes evil and is told.

test_scenarios.name: Only first chooser
test_scenarios.setup: Alice Goon (good), Bob Monk, Carol Imp; Bob acts before Carol.
test_scenarios.actions: Bob protects Alice, then Carol attacks Alice.
test_scenarios.expected: Bob is drunk (no protection) and Alice stays good; Carol is not drunk, so Alice dies.

test_scenarios.name: Assassin kills Goon
test_scenarios.expected: Eve is drunk but Alice still dies (per the wiki ruling) and Alice turns evil.

test_scenarios.name: Poisoned Goon
test_scenarios.expected: Bob is not drunk and Alice's alignment is unchanged.

test_scenarios.name: Grandmother does not trigger
test_scenarios.setup: Alice Goon is Bob Grandmother's grandchild.
test_scenarios.expected: No drunkenness and no alignment change.
